primary.title: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees to meet today, 19 Nov: Expectations, latest update, time, location, likely agenda
primary.summary: EPFO will hold its 240th Central Board of Trustees meeting in New Delhi on 19 November 2026. It is expected to discuss raising the minimum monthly EPS pension and giving subscribers more retirement withdrawal options.
